<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 771">Yalk. Num. 771</cite> (ref. to <he>כאהלים</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 24:6">Num. XXIV, 6</cite>) <he>כפלוטין</he> (corr. acc.) like foliatum.
<cite ref="Numbers 24:6">Ib.</cite> <he>אתה מכנה אותן בבצלים … מכנה אותן בפליטון</he> thou (Balaam) comparest them to onions whose smell is offensive, but I (the Lord) compare them to spikenard oil.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:9">Tosef. Sot. XV, 9</cite> <he>אף על פי׳ גזר וכ׳</he> Ben Baba forbade also the use of foliatum (after the destruction of the Temple), but &c.; a. e.
